description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the LocationDao class in the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It contains setup code and multiple test methods verifying the behavior of LocationDao functions such as retrieving locations by ID, searching locations with filters, and getting location IDs associated with employees.

classes.name: LocationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for LocationDao testing various methods related to location data retrieval and search functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LocationDao instance and populates test data from a YAML fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a location by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLocationByIdForNonExistingId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a non-existing location ID, expecting null.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Verifies the number of employees for a specific location.

methods.name: testGetLocationList
methods.description: Checks if the list of location IDs is retrieved correctly.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForNullArray
methods.description: Tests search locations with default (null/empty) filter, expecting all locations.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForLocationName
methods.description: Filters locations by name and tests the search results.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Gets the count of locations matching certain filters.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves location IDs associated with multiple employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesOneEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of location IDs for a single employee.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesNoEmployees
methods.description: Tests retrieval with an empty employee list, expecting empty result.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesEmployeesWithoutLocations
methods.description: Tests retrieval for employee IDs with no associated locations.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesInvalidEmployees
methods.description: Tests retrieval with invalid/non-existent employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetLocationsByIds
methods.description: Checks retrieval of locations based on a list of location IDs.
